hypotheses.justification: The same proof works with this instance omitted. `drinfeldFunctionField` is `FractionRing (CoordRing q k)`, whose commutative ring and k-algebra structures exist without a domain assumption; `sc` needs only these structures. `scalarOf_pow_of_mem` likewise has no domain assumption.
